# Setup

```{r}
# Alternative datasets for student report
library(Seurat)
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v5")
library(SeuratData)

if(F){
  AvailableData()
  InstallData("pbmcsca")
}
data("pbmcsca")
pbmcsca <- UpdateSeuratObject(pbmcsca)
table(pbmcsca$Method)
```

# 1. Subset Data by Platform

```{r}
method_names <- unique(pbmcsca$Method)
platform_list <- list()
for (m in method_names) {
  sub_obj <- pbmcsca[, pbmcsca$Method == m]
  if (ncol(sub_obj) > 500) {
    platform_list[[m]] <- sub_obj
  }
}

```

# 2. Initialize result storage

```{r}
results <- data.frame(
  Platform = character(),
  RareCluster = character(),
  TopMarker = character(),
  DetectionRate = numeric(),
  RareClusterCells = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# 3. Rare cell marker

```{r}
marker_gene_list <- c("FOXP3", "LILRA4", "CD34", "GNLY", "PPBP")
```


# 4. Standard Preprocessing/Clustering

```{r}
for (plat_name in names(platform_list)) {
  cat("Processing:", plat_name, "\n")
  seurat_obj <- platform_list[[plat_name]]
  
  # Preprocess
  seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
  seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj)
  seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj)
  seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj)
  seurat_obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj, dims=1:10)
  seurat_obj <- FindClusters(seurat_obj, resolution=0.6)
  seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims=1:10)
  
  # Count cells per cluster
  cluster_counts <- table(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters)
  print(cluster_counts)
  total_cells <- length(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters)
  
  # Define rare clusters (<1% total cells)
  cluster_pct <- prop.table(cluster_counts)
  rare_clusters <- names(cluster_pct)[cluster_pct < 0.01]
  rare_cells <- sum(cluster_counts[rare_clusters])
  
  # Marker detection rate (proportion of cells expressing marker >0)
  for (marker_gene in marker_gene_list) {
    marker_expr <- FetchData(seurat_obj, vars = marker_gene)[, 1]
    detection_rate <- sum(marker_expr > 0) / length(marker_expr)
  }
  
  # Store results
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Platform=plat_name,
    TotalCells=total_cells,
    RareClusterCells=rare_cells,
    MarkerDetectionRate=detection_rate
  ))
}

print(results)
write.csv(results, file = 'results.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```

# 5. Visualize with barplot

```{r}
barplot(results$MarkerDetectionRate, 
        names.arg=results$Platform, 
        main="Marker Detection Rate Across Platforms", 
        ylab="Detection Rate",
        las = 2,
        cex.names = 0.5)

barplot(results$RareClusterCells, 
        names.arg=results$Platform, 
        main="Rare Cluster Cell Counts Across Platforms", 
        ylab="Cell Count",
        las = 2,
        cex.names = 0.5)
```
